summary.value: Junior's Times Square is the cheesecake restaurant at 1515 Broadway at 45th Street in Times Square.

description.value: Junior's Times Square is the Midtown branch of the Brooklyn cheesecake landmark. It is at 1515 Broadway @ 45th Street, in the middle of the Theater District. Posted hours include Sunday – Monday 7am - 11pm, so it works for a late slice after a show.
